entries.name: Split-Stance Broad Jump — fixed lead, two-foot reception
entries.sourceName: Split-Stance Broad Jump — fixed lead, two-foot reception
entries.instruction: Main asymmetric leg contribution to a forward push while retaining a bilateral landing. Start in a modest split stance, front whole foot loaded and rear foot assisting. Use one small dip and project a short distance; land with feet parallel and hold 2 s. Repeat with the other lead leg; this is not a single-leg takeoff. Recovery: 90 s between complete set rounds; complete one leg's bout, rest 60 s, then the other leg; 8 total reps; 10 s between individual reps; 90 s before the next exercise/section Use instead: a shorter split-stance jump, or the Week 1 parallel broad jump if asymmetry loses the forward line; record the changed start. This replaces remaining work in this slot; follow an explicit replacement dose if stated, otherwise keep the remaining dose/rest. Log changed events or laterality.
